You will get opportunities to experience the Everglades wilderness and its diverse habitats, animals, human history, and the vital water of the “river of grass”. This trip can be very strenuous! Please consider your abilities and only sign up if you are physically fit and have prior canoeing experience.

facts.detailsText: Paddling in Paradise: Ranger-Guided Kayak on Florida Bay Where to Meet: Please meet us at the Flamingo Marina (Florida Bay side), about 60 minutes from the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center in Homestead. ADDRESS: 1 Flamingo Lodge Highway, Flamingo, FL 33034 When to Meet: We ask that you arrive by 8 am to take care of last-minute logistics, sign your waivers, and prepare to paddle. If you do not check-in with a ranger by 8:15 am, your place on the tour may be forfeited to other visitors. If you miss the 8:30 am safety talk, you are not permitted on the paddle. What to Bring: Water (required) Closed-toe shoes with good tread (required) Snacks Hat Sunglasses Sunscreen Bug spray or bug jacket Binoculars Towel Dry bags Breathable long-sleeve shirt and long pants Important Reminders: Prior paddling experience, water, and closed-toe shoes with strong tread are required. If rangers don't feel you can complete the trip safely, they may ask you to remove yourself from the trip. All minors (16+) must have an adult (18+) in the kayak with them. Everyone will be issued life jackets and are required to wear them for the entire paddle. All visitors are required to sign a waiver. Parents or legal guardians can sign for minors. You may be asked to help us lift or move kayaks short distances. Plan to get wet. You may want to leave valuables, such as phones or cameras, behind so they don't get wet. A park ranger will bring a dry bag for your car keys but will not carry any other belongings for you. The park and its rangers are not responsible for any damage to your personal belongings. We look forward to seeing you in the ‘Glades soon! You will check-in with a park ranger at the Florida Bay Marina, about 40 miles past the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center. Allow up to 60 minutes for this drive. Follow signs for Flamingo. Please arrive at least 30 minutes early to check-in (arrive by 8 am). If you are late, we reserve the right to give another visitor your place. Upon arrival, you will be required to sign a waiver before joining the tour. Adults over the age of 18 must complete and submit their own waiver. Minors ages 17 and younger must have a parent or legal guardian sign a waiver on behalf of the minor.
